evals.name: basic-search
evals.prompt: Search for the latest news about OpenAI GPT-5
evals.expected_output: Tavily search results with relevant articles about GPT-5

evals.name: search-with-filters
evals.prompt: Search for 'Python async programming tutorials' but only from realpython.com and docs.python.org, and only from the last 30 days
evals.expected_output: Filtered search results from specified domains within last 30 days

evals.name: deep-research
evals.prompt: Start a deep research task on 'the impact of AI on software engineering jobs in 2024'
evals.expected_output: Research job ID returned for async research task

evals.name: extract-content
evals.expected_output: Extracted article content in structured format

evals.name: crawl-website
evals.prompt: Crawl the Python documentation site https://docs.python.org/3/tutorial/ and get the first 5 pages
evals.expected_output: Crawled content from up to 5 pages of the tutorial

evals.name: map-website
evals.prompt: Map the structure of https://docs.python.org and limit to 20 URLs
